title.narrative: Universal Access to Malaria Prevention and Treatment in Angola - Angola (01-Jul-2018-31-Dec-2019)

description.narrative: Angola, Malaria, Ministry of Health of the Republic of Angola (MOH)This program has the following goals: Reduce by 60% the morbidity of malaria from 14% in 2016 to 6% by 2020. Reduce by 60% the mortality of malaria from 53,8% in 2016 to 21,5% by 2020. The objectives of this program are: By the end of 2020, at least 80% of the target population uses an adequate preventive measure;. By the end of 2020, 100% of suspected malaria cases at health facility, private pharmacies and community levels are tested before receiving treatment;. By the end of 2020, 100% of malaria cases testing positive are treated according to the national guidelines, at all levels of the national health pyramid, including at community level;. By the end of 2020, ensure that the Angolan population uses at least 80% of the planned malaria control interventions;. By 2020, strengthen the epidemiology surveillance system, monitoring and evaluation and operational research;. By 2020, strengthen the management, technical and institutional capacities of the National Malaria Control Program (NMCP) at all levels, to enable efficient and sustainable implementation of the planned activities of the NMCP.
